name: R01_pure_bull_2017
description: 2017 was a steady QQQ bull market (+30%). The algorithm should hold QQQ throughout with minimal or zero rotations.
expected_behavior: Few or zero rotations, final position QQQ, positive return tracking buy-and-hold

name: R02_bull_to_bear_2008
description: 2008 financial crisis. QQQ fell ~41%, TLT rallied ~33% (flight to safety). Algorithm should rotate to TLT.
expected_behavior: Rotation QQQ→TLT in early-to-mid 2008. End year in TLT or CASH. Strategy should preserve capital or even gain.

name: R03_bull_to_bear_2022
description: 2022 bear market with bonds falling too. QQQ -33%, TLT -30%. THIS is the TLT health check test — algorithm should rotate to CASH, not TLT.
expected_behavior: Rotation QQQ→CASH (not TLT). End year in CASH. Strategy should significantly outperform buy-and-hold.

name: R04_whipsaw_2010
description: 2010 had multiple choppy pullbacks (May flash crash, August China scare). Tests whipsaw handling. Memory shows backtest produced -2.84% that year.
expected_behavior: Multiple rotations, possibly underperforms B&H, final position likely QQQ at year-end

name: R05_whipsaw_2015
description: 2015 was the strategy's worst calendar year (-10.81% per backtest). August China crash whipsaw. Tests whipsaw under stress.
expected_behavior: Multiple rotations, significant underperformance vs B&H, final position likely QQQ

name: R06_breakout_recovery_2009
description: 2009 was the recovery year after 2008 crisis. Tests re-entry after extended defensive period.
expected_behavior: Re-entry signal fires sometime in 2009. End year in QQQ. Likely lags B&H significantly.

name: R07_covid_crash_2020
description: 2020 had the COVID crash (Mar) and immediate recovery. Tests rapid regime breaks. Memory: backtest +41.74% that year.
expected_behavior: Rotation in Feb-Mar, re-entry later in year. End in QQQ. Strong positive year.

name: R08_strong_bull_2024
description: 2024 was another strong bull year (+27% QQQ). Tests behavior in strong sustained uptrend. Memory: backtest +21.54%.
expected_behavior: Few or zero rotations, final position QQQ, positive return slightly lagging B&H
